title: A Central Limit Theorem for the Ewens-Pitman random partition in the large-$θ$ regime via a martingale approach
summary: The Ewens-Pitman model defines a distribution on random partitions of $\{1,\ldots,n\}$, with parameters $α\in [0,1)$ and $θ> -α$; the case $α=0$ reduces to the classical Ewens model from population genetics. We investigate the large-$n$ asymptotic behaviour of the Ewens-Pitman random partition in the nonstandard regime $θ=λn$ with $λ>0$, establishing joint fluctuation results for the total number of blocks $K_n^{\{n\}}$ and the counts $K_{r,n}^{\{n\}}$ of blocks of sizes $r=1,\dots,d$, for fixed $d\in\mathbb{N}$.
